title: FPS Horror game co-deved with Claude over a couple days
author: RedTowerStudio
selftext:
I had this project idea a while back but gave up due to time constraints. 

Recently been a bit burnt out on a larger project so I am trying to make a smaller project I can finish in a few weeks. This is two days in now using Claude Opus 5.5, Blender, and Godot. I make a GDD document consisting of Story, Style, and Mechanics along with a dev log that sessions communicate through when needed. Mostly just eyeballing, prompting, and drawing out what the stuff I want generally looks like. Audio is from mostly pixlebay or made by claude. 

I'm aiming for a pretty crunchy PSX style, but I feel like it is still a bit to grainy. 

The game is about a guy named Ben who has had a tragic past few months. He is up at his cabin drinking away his life after he lost his family, career, and reputation. On a stormy night he is suddenly brought into what seems to be the end of the world. You gather pieces of the story as you try to escape with your life and your dog, but where is there to escape when the whole world is damned anyhow?

replies.author: RedTowerStudio
replies.body:
Yeah, I have no idea how to create good voices through ai tbh. I can solo voice a single character, but not a cast so that is a big constraint I have found. I am using a relatively small local model along with a few public libary and adding in tags to try to get it somewhat... palatable. But yeah that was probably 30% of the time alone so far.   
  
Thanks for watching btw!
